broad_run.failure: The new font probe queried the native textarea element, whose painted text lives in a user-agent shadow descendant. No rendered font was returned for that element.

checks.correction: The CDP probe now scrolls the real control into view and inspects its actual painted text owner, including native shadow descendants and CodeMirror token spans. Font assertions are retained.

focused_recheck.command: cd tests/e2e && WOOBE_CAPTURE_DOCS=1 WOOBE_REQUIRE_GEORGIA=1 npx playwright test --config review.config.ts --workers=1 --grep 'production primitives, variants and actual rendered fonts'
